text:
Aaron M: Quick sync — I pushed a staging dashboard that combines runtime latency, per-model token throughput, kv-cache hit rates, and the new SLO burn metric. Need ops + oncall input on alert thresholds and pager routing. https://dash.redwood/staging/runtime-telemetry :eyes:

Maya S: Saw it, looks neat. Can you call out which series map to customer-facing SLOs vs infra-only metrics? We should only page on the customer-facing ones.

Aaron M: Good point. Marked these with `slo_scope="customer"` in the panels. Also added a derived series `slo_burn_rate` (slo_burn_total / slo_budget_total).

Chris L: Question: are we treating bursty short spikes as page-worthy? We had noise on the old runtime p50/p95 alerts. Suggest using a 10m window + increase threshold for p95.

Priya K: For SLO burn, ops prefers a two-tiered approach: warn (slack) at 1%-5% burn in 10m, page if sustained >5% for 15m or if cumulative 1h burn >10%. That maps to how we judge regressions in CI.

Tom B: Agree with Priya. Add an escalation policy: first page to runtime-oncall, if no ack in 10m escalate to infra-oncall. Also route model-heavy clusters to the model-serving rotation (use `region=ml` tag).

Maya S: Small nit — add a low-sensitivity variant for dev and staging so we don't wake people at 3am. Prod only pages.

Aaron M: Plan draft for alert rule (posting so you can copy):
```yaml
alert: RuntimeSLOBurnHigh
expr: max_over_time(slo_burn_rate{slo_scope=\"customer\",env=\"prod\"}[15m]) > 0.05
for: 15m
labels:
  severity: page
  team: runtime
annotations:
  summary: "High SLO burn detected ({{ $labels.service }})"
  runbook: "https://runbooks.redwood/runtime/slo-burn"
```

Priya K: That looks good. Can we also add a secondary alert for short spikes so we get early visibility in #runtime-alerts (no page):
```yaml
alert: RuntimeSLOBurnSpike
expr: increase(slo_burn_total{slo_scope=\"customer\",env=\"prod\"}[10m]) / increase(slo_budget_total{env=\"prod\"}[10m]) > 0.02
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: ticket
  team: runtime
annotations:
  summary: "SLO burn spike (seen in dashboard)"
```

Chris L: For routing, we should use label-based mapping: severity=page -> rotation=runtime-oncall, team=runtime. severity=ticket -> slack channel #runtime-alerts. Also include `region` tag so we can fallback to multi-region oncall if a region is down.

OncallBot: Dashboard "staging/runtime-telemetry" created by Aaron M at 2026-03-20T14:12:03Z. Links: edit / view / share.

Tom B: Can we add a short playbook stub in the annotation pointing to quick mitigations? e.g., check kv-cache hit rate, check batching queue depth, and model fallback status. Saves 1st responders time.

Aaron M: Will add runbook snippet. Also adding a `noisy_metric_filter` to suppress alerts for known transient spikes from autoscaling events. Example: `unless increase(autoscaler_events_total[10m]) > 0`. Thoughts?

Maya S: Fine, but make the suppression opt-in per-service. We don't want to hide real regressions for some customers.

Priya K: Ops actionables: (1) confirm pager rotations mapping (runtime-oncall person/team IDs) (2) agree on thresholds above (3) bless the staging->prod promotion steps (alert rule + playbook)

Chris L: I'll update the alert manager routing config once thresholds are final. Aaron, leave the rule in a draft folder and I'll import after review.

Aaron M: Thanks. I'll update the dashboard panels with the `slo_scope` labels, add the runbook links, and push the draft alerts into `ops/alerts/drafts/runtime-slo-burn.yaml`.

Tom B: One more: telemetry engineer should add a histogram for token throughput per model to help set model-specific thresholds. @Maya can you own that?

Maya S: Yup, will add histogram and a small eval job to compute typical baseline for each model over 7d. ETA EOD Friday.

Priya K: I'll schedule a short call Friday 11am to rubber-stamp thresholds. If no objections in thread, we'll promote to prod Monday.

Aaron M: Great — thanks everyone. Tagging the follow-ups: @Maya S (histogram & eval), @Chris L (routing import), @Tom B (runbook snippet), @Priya K (confirm rotations). :thumbsup:

OncallBot: Reminder: Escalation policy "runtime-oncall -> infra-oncall" configured for severity=page.

Chris L: I'll drop the draft AM config in the PR: https://git.re/redwood/ops/alertmanager/pulls/234

Aaron M: End of thread — will update PR + dashboard links when done.
